docs.text: 1. Found that if I shorten a video to 5 seconds, I can share it here! 2. The sound of the Great Lakes. 3. The view of the Mackinac (pronounced Mack-in-aw) Bridge. The bridge connects Michigan’s Upper and Lower Peninsulas. This view is from St Ignace in the Upper Peninsula.

Harbor Springs Michigan Harbor Springs, Michigan is a beautiful little resort town south of the Mackinaw Bridge at the northern part of the Lower Peninsula of Michigan. The town is sheltered by Little Traverse Bay on the shores of Lake MIchigan. The town gets its name from the natural springs that flow into the harbor.
Ghost Ship on Lake Superior. See it bigger here:

A different perspective of the Mackinac Bridge today. Standing beneath it in the fog, the steel seemed to disappear into the mist while the gentle waves lapped at the shore. A quiet moment in a place that has always felt like home.
A Tugboat on Lake Superior near Thunder Bay Ontario. See it bigger here:

Whitefish Bay is located on the eastern side of Lake Superior, with the international boundary between Michigan and Ontario, Canada, cutting across the bay. I've visited this beach countless times, and its allure never fades. It's incredibly easy to become lost in dreams while gazing out across the water.
Bulk Freighter makes its way up Lake Superior on a very hot day. I felt like I was melting while taking this! Shot on expired Ilford HP5+

Harbor Springs Michigan Harbor Springs, Michigan is a little resort town just south of the Mackinaw Bridge at the northern part of the Lower Peninsula of Michigan. The town is sheltered by Little Traverse Bay on the Shores of Lake MIchigan. The town gets it's name from the natural springs that flow into the harbor. See the full image here: ,

The ferry S.S. Badger departs Ludington, Michigan, headed across Lake Michigan for Manitowoc, Wisconsin, 16 August, 2024. Photo by Jim Bertolina. “Twin grandsons visiting from North Carolina. They couldn’t wait this morning to wave to the Badger” - photographer Jim Bertolina

The S.S. Badger is a steamship/car ferry that makes daily trips this time of year across Lake Michigan from Ludington, Michigan to Manitowoc on the Wisconsin side. Another one of those day trip “bucket list” items for me. Spencer Hanson got this shot of the Badger last night as it left Ludington. “A bit breezy but another gorgeous sky in Ludington this evening as the Badger departs for a night crossing.” - photographer Spencer Hanson

Downtown Harbor Springs II Down Town Harbor Springs II is a capture of Downtown Harbor Springs Michigan taken from the bluff overlooking the town and Little Traverse Bay. This scenic small town sits on the western edge of Michigan on the eastern shore of Lake Michigan roughly 45 minutes south of the Straits Of Mackinaw and the Mackinaw Bridge.

Photo by Jeff Mast. “The blurred steam exhaust behind the stack shows the slow shutter speed to capture this moment, the details as I hand held the camera against one of the overhead walkway supports on the breakwater pier.” - Jeff Mast

Grand Hotel - Mackinac Island The beautiful and historic Grand Hotel sits on a hill on Mackinac Island on Lake Huron overlooking the Straits Of Mackinaw in Northern Michigan. The hotel was built in the later part of the 19th century and markets itself as having the worlds longest porch at 660 ft. in length. See the full image here: -MackinacIsland LakeHuron

Fort Mackinac. Third photo is one of the residential houses on the island. Fourth is a view of Lake Huron from a hill. Fifth photo is another walking trail with a horse drawn carriage passing by. Sixth is the Golf Course. Shot in July 2023.
